snippet.title: LitGirls: Bookbound Dungeons - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
LitGirls: Bookbound Dungeons is a dungeon-crawler RPG where classic literature meets anime Girls! Assemble a party inspired by legendary characters such as Alice, Juliet, Dante, and Raven, then lead them into treacherous dungeons crawling with monsters, traps, treasure, and otherworldly horrors.

The responsibility of saving the world falls to YOU... so delegate it to your Girls!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4181850/LitGirls_Bookbound_Dungeons/

Developer: NANAIRO ENTERPRISE
X: https://x.com/LitGirls_Game
